en_US.title: Worker Roster Size Rule
en_US.scanner: The colony roster is large enough to feel inhabited and small enough to stay authored.
en_US.field_note: Lock 72 worker identities: 24 anchor names for recurring evidence, 48 seed-role names for replay variation.
en_US.terminal: ROSTER RULE: 72 authored worker identities. Anchor names may recur across lockers, ledgers and audio. Seed-role identities vary object pairing by run.
en_US.audio: A name is evidence only when the room can prove the job.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The Worker Roster Size Rule prevents both anonymous ruins and uncontrolled name spam.
en_US.external_site: Worker Roster Size Rule defines the HECTON-8 colony name pool for wiki, game and prop writing.

ru_RU.title: Правило размера worker roster
ru_RU.scanner: Список колонии достаточно большой, чтобы место было населенным, и достаточно малый, чтобы остаться авторским.
ru_RU.field_note: Фикс: 72 worker identities. 24 anchor names для повторяющихся evidence, 48 seed-role names для replay variation.
ru_RU.terminal: ROSTER RULE: 72 authored worker identities. Anchor names могут повторяться в lockers, ledgers и audio. Seed-role identities меняют связку объектов по run.
ru_RU.audio: Имя становится доказательством только когда комната доказывает работу.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Правило размера worker roster защищает от анонимных руин и неконтролируемого name spam.
ru_RU.external_site: Правило размера worker roster задает пул имен колонии HECTON-8 для wiki, игры и props.

en_US.title: Pressure Crew Archetype Table
en_US.scanner: Crews are verbs: pump, seal, relay, map, forge, triage, cultivate, witness.
en_US.field_note: Use eight crew families: Pump, Seal, Relay, Brine Map, Vent Forge, Triage, Pressure Botany and Payload Witness.
en_US.terminal: CREW FAMILIES: Pump / Seal / Relay / Brine Map / Vent Forge / Triage / Pressure Botany / Payload Witness. Names attach to route function first.
en_US.audio: Job first. Memory second. That is how the colony survives.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Pressure crew archetypes keep worker evidence tied to systems the player can understand and repair.
en_US.external_site: Pressure Crew Archetype Table gives HECTON-8 colony writing a practical labor structure.
